# Move player to gray square at (16,16) and see if it's collected
def ppos():
    bb=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    blue=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if bb[r][c]=='b' and 5<r<60 and c<40]
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in blue)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in blue))
    return (rs[0],rs[-1],cs[0],cs[-1])
print("pos:", ppos())
action(['LEFT'])
print("after LEFT:", ppos())

action(['DOWN'])

print("after DOWN changed rows:", ch, "pos:", ppos())

# check if gray square still there
seg=current_frame.segmentation
gray=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='g']
for n in gray:
    bnd=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in bnd]; cols=[p[1] for p in bnd]
    print("gray:", n['id'], "px",n['pixels'], "rows",min(rows),max(rows),"cols",min(cols),max(cols))
</parameter>
</function>
